name: adzuna-mcp
description: Adzuna (jobs): me, search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_adzuna_app_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADZUNA_APP_ID
platform_mcp_adzuna_app_id.description: Adzuna app_id from https://developer.adzuna.com/ (register with username, e-mail, organisation name + website); mandatory app_id query parameter on every call.

platform_mcp_adzuna_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADZUNA_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_adzuna_app_key.description: Adzuna app_key from https://developer.adzuna.com/; mandatory app_key query parameter on every call.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified with a one-result UK search (Adzuna has no account endpoint).

tools.name: search
tools.description: The country is a path segment (gb, us, de, fr, ... per the Adzuna site); this server is pinned to gb (UK). description is cropped by Adzuna and redirect_url opens the ad on the original board. Rate limits are not published (plans are managed by the 3scale portal).
